correctness.rationale: Strict concavity and positive feasible perturbations prove uniqueness/interiority. KKT yields the scaling equations. A Pell quadratic invariant proves the exact half-line normalization, and uniform diagonal dominance controls finite-path residuals, giving convergence and the surface term. The standalone script performed 320 supplementary exact, symbolic and numerical checks, explicitly not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical family of uniformly stationary birth–death walks on paths has a non-obvious alternating limiting boundary conductance profile and exact nonzero entropy surface correction. The result is valid at every fixed endpoint distance in all long paths, quantitatively distinguishes entropy-rate optimization from spectral mixing, and provides interpretable limiting design parameters rather than a narrow accidental finite case.
